t: DEF CON 21 - Karl Koscher and Eric Butler - The Secret Life of SIM Cards

q.x: This is a classic defcon talk about it. They developed their own cell network with their own sim cards for an event and even built custom JavaCard applications their users could use.

desc:
The Secret Life of SIM Cards 
KARL KOSCHER GRAD STUDENT, UNIVERSITY OF WASHINGTON 
ERIC BUTLER

SIM cards can do more than just authenticate your phone with your carrier. Small apps can be installed and run directly on the SIM separate from and without knowledge of the phone OS.
